summary: Duelist who wins through vitals (true %HP damage) and Riposte (W), which parries your key crowd control. Strong 1v1 at every stage; beat her by baiting W and punishing its cooldown.
threats: Vitals (Duelist's Dance): she repositions to strike the marked side for true damage and move speed.
Riposte (W) blocks damage and debuffs, and stuns you if it parried your CC.
Q (Lunge) cooldown is refunded when she hits a vital, so short trades favor her.
R (Grand Challenge) at level 5 marks four vitals; hitting all of them creates a healing zone.

matchups.why: Pantheon's level 1–5 damage is among the highest in Baron lane, and Comet Spear poke keeps her low before she can trade. Aegis Assault (E) blocks her damage from the front.
trading: Throw empowered Q (at 5 Mortal Will stacks) when she walks up to last-hit.
Only use W (Shield Vault) stun after she has used Riposte.
When she Lunges in, E to block her trade, then counter-trade.
Keep facing her so she can't easily hit the vital behind you.
matchups.early: Win the lane early. Pantheon falls off, so push for a kill or plates before 10 minutes.
matchups.spike: At 5, R gives map pressure. If she's farming safely, use it to swing mid or Dragon lane.
matchups.wave: Push and take plates while she can't contest your poke.
matchups.jungle: W stun sets up a kill for your jungler; call the gank once her W is down.

matchups.why: Kennen is ranged and fast; Fiora must Lunge onto him to trade, and he can walk away with Lightning Rush. Riposte can only parry one ability, not the whole poke pattern.
trading: Auto + Q (Thundering Shuriken) poke at range; she must use Q to answer.
After she Lunges in, E (Lightning Rush) away and resume poking.
Don't apply your third stun mark while her W is up; she'll parry and stun you back.
matchups.early: Your early poke grounds her. Harass her off every last-hit and keep the wave near your side.
matchups.spike: At 5, R plus ignite makes her all-in very risky; if she dives you, stand in your R and stun her.
matchups.wave: Hold the wave on your side; she can't reach you without walking through poke.
matchups.jungle: Once you land the stun, call your jungler. Avoid playing for it while her W is ready.
matchups.build: Electrocute. AP damage items; early boots for spacing.
matchups.remember: Respect W. You win by poke, not by stun.

matchups.why: Both are cooldown duelists: Jax's Counter Strike dodges her autos, but her Riposte can parry his stun. Whoever wastes their parry first usually loses the trade.
trading: Hold E (Counter Strike) until she commits to an auto or Lunge.
If she parries your E stun, back off; she has the next trade.
Leap Strike (Q) onto her only after her W is down for an extended fight.
matchups.early: Even. Track her W and your E cooldowns and only fight when yours is up and hers isn't.
matchups.spike: R gives you armor and MR plus extra on-hit; both of you scale well into side-lane 1v1s.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight on cooldown windows; don't fight in a big enemy wave.
matchups.jungle: Ganks work best after she's used W on a creep wave or your E.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Trinity Force-style bruiser items; armor boots.
matchups.remember: Whoever burns their parry first loses.

matchups.why: Fiora parries Garen's Q silence with Riposte and stuns him, then shreds his HP with vitals. Garen has no way to stick to her when she dashes out.
trading: Never Q into her while W is up. It gets parried and you get stunned.
W (Courage) tenacity cuts her stun duration; activate it when she commits.
Short trades only after she has used W.
matchups.early: Play safe and farm with E. Don't contest her for creeps when Q is up.
matchups.spike: Your R can execute her, but Riposte can block it, so use R after her W is down.
matchups.wave: Let her push into you and farm under tower.
matchups.jungle: Ask for a gank early. She's weak to CC chains once W is used.
matchups.build: Phase Rush to kite away. Armor boots.
matchups.remember: Make her use W before you commit.

matchups.why: Fiora's vitals deal true %max HP damage, so your HP stacking feeds her. Riposte parries your charged Q and stuns you back, which takes away your main engage. If you're locked in, poke with E, scale, and win as a team-fight tank.
trading: Throw E (Roar of the Slayer) when she walks up; it's spell damage she has to Riposte or eat.
Charge Q only after she has used Riposte; otherwise she parries it and stuns you.
Shield with W when she Lunges onto a vital, then recast it as she backs off.
Turn so her vitals aren't facing her approach; don't let her chain vitals for free.
matchups.early: Farm safely and poke with E. Don't take short trades into her Q-into-vital pattern.
matchups.spike: At 5 her R wins duels; don't fight it. Use your R to roam or join fights while she's in a side lane.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; ping her when she shoves so your jungler can collapse.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with Lunge. Gank once Lunge or Riposte is on cooldown.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Armor boots; avoid relying on HP stacking alone.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Mordekaiser's E pull and stuns him back, and vitals' true damage ignores his shield. Fiora wins inside his R because it makes the fight a pure 1v1. If you're locked in, poke with Q and hold your R for team fights.
trading: Q (Obliterate) her when she walks up to farm; it's your safest damage and she has to Riposte or eat it.
Only cast E (Death's Grasp) after she has used Riposte; otherwise she parries it and stuns you.
Shield with W (Indestructible) when she Lunges onto a vital, then recast to heal.
Don't take long trades; her vitals heal her and refund Lunge every time she hits one.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Back off when she has Riposte up and you're in Lunge range.
matchups.spike: At 5 don't R her in lane; she wins the 1v1. Save it for a carry in team fights.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; ping your jungler when she shoves.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with Lunge. Gank once Lunge or Riposte is on cooldown and pull her into your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots; Zhonya's Hourglass to survive her R.

matchups.why: Fiora's vitals deal true %max HP damage that ignores your tankiness, and Riposte parries your E stun and stuns you back. If you're locked in, bait Riposte first and use W to stop her Lunge.
trading: Cast W (Steadfast Presence) when she Lunges toward a vital; it stops the dash.
Only E her after she has used Riposte; otherwise she parries it and stuns you.
Turn so her vitals aren't facing her approach; don't let her chain vitals for free.
Q (Hammer Shock) and walk away rather than standing in long trades.
matchups.early: Farm safely and trade only when Riposte is down. Her Q-into-vital trades out-damage yours.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R can knock her away from her heal zone. Save it for her R.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; your E near the tower walls punishes dives.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with Lunge. Gank with W ready to stop it.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Armor boots; avoid relying on HP alone.
